INPUT1 is the EDIT TARGET and costume identity. Preserve this costume's distinctive silhouette and hardware: WORK coat: dark dusty navy long worker coat, small olive backpack, rust-red scarf, dark brimmed miner cap with small square lamp. Keep coat hem at knees.
INPUT2 is the corrected SERVICE POSE and PIXEL STYLE TEMPLATE. Replace INPUT1's side/combat-like stances with the exact THREE back-three-quarter poses of INPUT2. RIGHT: WORKBENCH, shoulders turned further away from viewer and slight forward lean, hands closely together working at unseen bench. Distinguishable from shop.
Exactly three full-body figures in1536x1024 transparent RGBA atlas, 3equal512px columns, >=32px blank alpha gutter from each cell edge, head about y190-220 and boots y880. All three same human scale. Every hand/hat/backpack stays within column. Match reference2 silhouette proportions and muted medium-sized pixel cluster density at game display about120px high, NOT giant flat pixel-icon blocks.
Keep colored edges thin and selective, no continuous black outline. Dusty bluegray shadows, little warm rim on shoulder/hand, no stark white headlamp. Broad coherent cloth planes with a few smaller restrained clusters. No blur, airbrush, grain, random texture, dither, glossy illustration or dramatic glowing outlines.
OUTPUT only the three clothed figures on genuine transparent background. No furniture, objects, weapons, tools, floor shadows, panels, text, floor, UI or checkerboard. Do not add extra figures.
